facts.fact: The ILO says CAPMAS, with ILO support under the EU-funded THAMM Plus programme, agreed a roadmap with national institutions to strengthen administrative labour migration data, including a technical working group, electronic data exchange and a first unified bulletin, with implementation through 2027.
facts.system: THAMM Plus labour migration statistics roadmap

EGY.note: Censuses and labour force surveys are mentioned only in passing; no census or survey stated.
ILO recommendations and UN framework are statistical, not IT standards adopted.
